<h1 id="Stewart-(1977)-Yield-Response-to-Water-Stress">Stewart (1977) Yield Response to Water Stress<a class="anchor-link" href="#Stewart-(1977)-Yield-Response-to-Water-Stress">¶</a></h1><p><strong>Citation:</strong> Stewart, J.I. et al. (1977); documented in Allen et al. (1998) <em>FAO-56,</em> Chapter 10.</p>
<p><strong>AirSpring linkage:</strong> primal <code>science.yield_response</code>; Rust binary <code>validate_yield_response</code>.</p>
<p>Sources: <code>control/yield_response/yield_response.py</code> + <code>benchmark_yield_response.json</code>.</p>
<p>The proportional deficit model relates actual to maximum yield through the seasonal water deficit and crop-specific sensitivity $K_\mathrm{y}$.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="cell border-box-sizing text_cell rendered"><div class="inner_cell">
<div class="text_cell_render border-box-sizing rendered_html">
<h2 id="Theory">Theory<a class="anchor-link" href="#Theory">¶</a></h2><p>Following Stewart's single-stage form (FAO-56 Chapter 10 presentation):</p>
<p>$$\left(1 - \frac{Y_\mathrm{a}}{Y_\mathrm{m}}\right) = K_\mathrm{y}\left(1 - \frac{ET_\mathrm{a}}{ET_\mathrm{m}}\right)$$</p>
<p>Equivalently, as implemented in airSpring controls:</p>
<p>$$\frac{Y_\mathrm{a}}{Y_\mathrm{m}} = 1 - K_\mathrm{y}\left(1 - \frac{ET_\mathrm{a}}{ET_\mathrm{c}}\right)$$</p>
<p>Multi-stage formulations multiply stage factors (FAO-56 Eq.\ 90). Water-use efficiency aggregates yield per unit actual evaporation:
$\mathrm{WUE} = Y / ET_\mathrm{a}$ using the mm–ha volumetric conventions in <code>yield_response.py</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
